notes.title: DragonStone Revenge v1.2 minor update addresses full screen launch
notes.content: DragonStone Revenge v1.2 minor update addresses full screen launch, locking some users out of a usable game resolution. The game will now launch in windowed mode, which should now allow all users to access the settings menu and choose a game resolution that best fits their system.

notes.title: DragonStone Revenge – 1 Day Left!
notes.content: [h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396293/a77fbee6d3eff44374a6984f3e7cde3ed060fa90.png"][/img][/h2][h3][i]Myranda's journey is full of dangers and pleasures. Will you help her get revenge and save the world?[/i][/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Vengeance and romance go side-by-side.[/h2][p][b]DragonStone Revenge launches tomorrow! [/b]Play as Myranda, a warrior betrayed and cast out who returns to a world filled with corruption. Driven by [b]revenge[/b] and a need to uncover the truth about her past, she must rise as the last heir to a [b]powerful bloodline[/b].[/p][p]Only she can unlock the [b]DragonStone[/b] and decide the future of the realm. The [b]choices you make will shape her relationships[/b] and determine the [b]outcome of the war[/b].[/p][p]Explore a detailed world full of [b]secrets, danger, and dangerous beauty[/b]. Combine sword fighting, stealth, and forbidden magic to defeat your enemies. You can form close bonds with [b]allies and lovers[/b], but not everyone can be trusted. As the DragonStone’s power grows inside her, a [b]darker side begins to surface[/b]. It’s up to you to guide her path and [b]decide who she becomes[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Get ready for the launch tomorrow! Wishlist now![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763260/DragonStone_Revenge/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
